text.p: Alliant Techsystems Inc said employees of its Defense Systems Group represented by Teamsters Union Local 1145 ended a strike with approval on Sunday of a new three-year contract.

The company said in a statement the vote ended a 14-day strike by the 474 members of the local following rejection of a contract offer on Oct 6. The employees are expected to return to work at 6 a.m. on Monday.
The vote followed "extensive negotiations between the company and the union both prior to and following the initial vote on Oct. 6," the statement said.

"At issue in the first proposal was language regarding outsourcing to meet changing economic conditions. Negotiations during the past week clarified the concerns of both parties on the outsourcing issue and resulted in agreement on procedures to be followed in future outsourcing.
"All other elements of the company's first proposal were unchanged."
